purpose: New development after failure of v1 confirmation; not confirmation or qualification

variants.v1: Original magnitude-or-pending-step separation flag; HC3 chi-square; reconstructed using unchanged fit and score calculations
variants.v2: Pending-step separation flag only; all fit coefficients, covariance, likelihood, score, PH, HC3 chi-square, Holm families and 1% threshold unchanged
variants.candidate_F: Offline sensitivity analysis of v2 HC3 W/q against F(q,n-k); this is an approximation, not an exact robust finite-sample reference, and is not enabled in the product

dgp: Unchanged dataset() from guarded-inference-study/1 with a new seed; true first-five signals and conditionally null remaining markers preserved
shared_stream: Same dataset and same 999 permutation row draws within each clinical basis across all diagnostic variants
failure_policy: Append once per owned index; retain failures and trace-local array metadata; no replacement
qualification: No variant can qualify from this development study. A new confirmation protocol, unused seeds and sealed sources are required.
